description.value: When you are the target of an attack, you may use your reaction to gain Resistance to damage for a number of rounds equal to a roll of the TD. You may use this ability once per long rest. While this ability is active, you cannot be reduced below 1 HP (regardless of how much damage you take).

system.bonus: Reaction when targeted by an attack: resistance to damage for TD rounds and your HP can't drop below 1. Once per long rest.
